summary: BioNTech SE filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting, at which shareholders approved all agenda items including Supervisory Board expansion and re-elections. The filing describes a routine shareholder meeting with 92% of share capital represented, but does not announce any acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special situation. While the company discusses its oncology pipeline focus, this is ordinary business strategy commentary. No deal terms, special event triggers, or structural changes are involved. This is a routine current report of an AGM and therefore not a special situation.
